datasets.name: ds_pva
queryLines: SELECT item_id, item_description, abc, organization_code, week_start, planned_pab, actual_end_on_hand, planned_sales_orders, actual_shipped, actual_po_received, planned_safety_stock, onhand_variance_abs, onhand_variance_pct, onhand_variance_dollar, shipped_variance_abs, onhand_status, applied_standard_cost, ABS(onhand_variance_pct) AS abs_var_pct, ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) AS abs_var_dollar, CASE WHEN onhand_status IN ('yellow','red') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS off_flag, CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN '3 · Off plan (>30%)' WHEN onhand_status='yellow' THEN '2 · Drifting (15–30%)' WHEN onhand_status='green' THEN '1 · On plan (≤15%)' ELSE '0 · No actual' END AS status_label , CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand<planned_safety_stock THEN (planned_safety_stock-actual_end_on_hand)*applied_standard_cost ELSE 0 END AS stockout_gap_dollar, CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand>3*planned_safety_stock THEN (actual_end_on_hand-3*planned_safety_stock)*applied_standard_cost ELSE 0 END AS excess_capital_dollar , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual

datasets.name: ds_week
queryLines: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago FROM ( SELECT week_start, COUNT(*) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_items, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='green' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS green_items, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS

avg_bias_pct, ROUND(SUM(onhand_variance_dollar),0) AS net_variance_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start )

datasets.name: ds_abc
queryLines: SELECT abc, COUNT(*) AS rows, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS avg_var_pct FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE abc IS NOT NULL AND abc<>'None' GROUP BY abc ORDER BY abc

datasets.name: ds_topexc
queryLines: SELECT item_id, item_description, abc, week_start, onhand_variance_abs, onhand_variance_pct, onhand_variance_dollar, onhand_status , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_status IN ('red','yellow') ORDER BY ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) DESC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ds_orgcmp
queryLines: SELECT organization_code, plan_name, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_iw, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='green' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS green_iw, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS avg_bias_pct, ROUND(SUM(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar)),0) AS total_abs_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY organization_code, plan_name ORDER BY organization_code

datasets.name: ds_planner
queryLines: SELECT planner_name, COUNT(*) AS item_weeks, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS avg_bias_pct, ROUND(SUM(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar)),0) AS total_abs_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_status<>'no-data' GROUP BY planner_name ORDER BY total_abs_dollar DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_tier
queryLines: SELECT alert_tier, COUNT(*) AS item_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS items FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY alert_tier ORDER BY alert_tier

datasets.name: ds_imbalance
queryLines: SELECT a.item_id, a.item_description, a.abc, a.actual_end_on_hand AS oh_olive_2012, b.actual_end_on_hand AS oh_mexico_2120, ROUND(a.actual_end_on_hand - b.actual_end_on_hand,0) AS spread FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual a JOIN sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual b ON a.item_id=b.item_id AND a.week_start=b.week_start WHERE a.organization_code='2012' AND b.organization_code='2120' AND a.week_start='2026-08-24' AND a.actual_end_on_hand>1000 AND b.actual_end_on_hand < a.actual_end_on_hand*0.05 ORDER BY spread DESC LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_scorecard
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, plan_name, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS items, COUNT(*) AS item_weeks, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS avg_overage_pct, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='green' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_green, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_red, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_unplanned, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN alert_tier LIKE '3%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_escalate, ROUND(AVG(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar)),0) AS avg_abs_var_dollar, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 THEN planned_safety_stock END),0) AS avg_ss_per_item, ROUND(SUM(actual_shipped)/NULLIF(SUM(actual_po_received),0),3) AS ship_receive_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT planner_name) AS planners FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY organization_code, plan_name ORDER BY organization_code

datasets.name: ds_scale_ctx
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, ROUND(SUM(actual_end_on_hand*applied_standard_cost),0) AS onhand_value_usd, ROUND(AVG(onhand_variance_pct),1) AS avg_overage_pct FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY organization_code ORDER BY organization_code

datasets.name: ds_varpct_long
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, 'p50' AS band, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar),0.50),0) AS var_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_variance_dollar IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code UNION ALL SELECT organization_code, 'p90', ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar),0.90),0) FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_variance_dollar IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code UNION ALL SELECT organization_code, 'p95', ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar),0.95),0) FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_variance_dollar IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code UNION ALL SELECT organization_code, 'p99', ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar),0.99),0) FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_variance_dollar IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code ORDER BY band, org

datasets.name: ds_sku_share_long
queryLines: WITH i AS (SELECT DISTINCT organization_code AS org, item_id FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual), shared AS (SELECT item_id FROM i GROUP BY item_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT org)>1) SELECT i.org, CASE WHEN s.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared across orgs' ELSE 'Org-exclusive' END AS sku_kind, COUNT(*) AS items FROM i LEFT JOIN shared s ON i.item_id=s.item_id GROUP BY i.org, CASE WHEN s.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared across orgs' ELSE 'Org-exclusive' END ORDER BY i.org, sku_kind

datasets.name: ds_planner_conc
queryLines: WITH p AS (SELECT organization_code AS org, planner_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_p FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY organization_code, planner_name) SELECT org, COUNT(*) AS planners, ROUND(100.0*MAX(rows_p)/SUM(rows_p),1) AS top_planner_share_pct FROM p GROUP BY org ORDER BY org

datasets.name: ds_exc_queue
queryLines: WITH base AS ( SELECT item_id, item_description, abc, organization_code AS org, organization_code, week_start, planner_name, onhand_variance_dollar, onhand_status, planned_pab, actual_end_on_hand, planned_safety_stock, onhand_variance_pct, CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NULL THEN 'Unplanned' WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand < planned_safety_stock THEN 'Stockout risk' WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand > 3*planned_safety_stock THEN 'Excess' WHEN onhand_variance_pct > 15 THEN 'Over-plan' WHEN onhand_variance_pct < -15 THEN 'Under-plan' ELSE 'Other' END AS exception_type, ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) AS abs_var_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_status IN ('red','yellow') ), worst AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id, org ORDER BY abs_var_dollar DESC) AS rn FROM base ), chronic AS ( SELECT DISTINCT item_ref, org, chronic_pct_late FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.p1flow_order_stage_gold WHERE lane='purchase' ) SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago, w.item_id, w.item_description, w.abc, w.org AS org, w.org AS organization_code, w.week_start, COALESCE(w.planner_name,'Unassigned') AS planner_name, w.exception_type, w.abs_var_dollar, w.onhand_variance_pct, w.actual_end_on_hand, w.planned_safety_stock, c.chronic_pct_late, CASE WHEN c.chronic_pct_late >= 60 THEN 'Systemic (chronic supplier)' ELSE 'One-off' END AS root_flag FROM worst w LEFT JOIN chronic c ON w.item_id=c.item_ref AND w.org=c.org WHERE w.rn=1 ORDER BY w.abs_var_dollar DESC LIMIT 500

datasets.name: ds_exc_pareto
queryLines: WITH base AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NULL THEN 'Unplanned' WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand < planned_safety_stock THEN 'Stockout risk' WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand > 3*planned_safety_stock THEN 'Excess' WHEN onhand_variance_pct > 15 THEN 'Over-plan' WHEN onhand_variance_pct < -15 THEN 'Under-plan' ELSE 'Other' END AS exception_type, ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) AS abs_var_dollar FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max AND onhand_status IN ('red','yellow') ) SELECT exception_type, COUNT(*) AS items, ROUND(SUM(abs_var_dollar),0) AS dollar_at_risk FROM base GROUP BY exception_type ORDER BY dollar_at_risk DESC

datasets.name: ds_accuracy_split
queryLines: WITH s AS ( SELECT organization_code, week_start, CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NULL THEN 'Unplanned' WHEN onhand_variance_abs>0 THEN 'Over-plan' WHEN onhand_variance_abs<0 THEN 'Under-plan' ELSE 'On-plan' END AS dir FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN

:wk.min AND :wk.max AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, week_start, dir, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY organization_code, week_start, dir ORDER BY week_start, org, dir

datasets.name: ds_sla
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NOT NULL AND planned_pab<>0 THEN ABS(onhand_variance_pct) END),1) AS onhand_mape, ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NOT NULL AND ABS(onhand_variance_pct)<=15 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),1) AS pct_within_15,

SUM(CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand<planned_safety_stock THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_items FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) GROUP BY
organization_code ORDER BY org

datasets.name: ds_abc_median
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, COALESCE(abc,'(none)') AS abc, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(onhand_variance_pct,0.5),1) AS median_var_pct, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(onhand_variance_pct,0.25),1) AS p25, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(onhand_variance_pct,0.75),1) AS p75 FROM

sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) AND planned_pab IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code, COALESCE(abc,'(none)') ORDER BY org, abc

datasets.name: ds_money_risk
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand<planned_safety_stock THEN (planned_safety_stock-actual_end_on_hand)*applied_standard_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS stockout_risk_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand>3*planned_safety_stock THEN (actual_end_on_hand-3*planned_safety_stock)*applied_standard_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS excess_capital_usd FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual GROUP BY organization_code ORDER BY org

datasets.name: ds_plan_evolution
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, target_week_start, CAST(snapshot_week AS DATE) AS snapshot_week, ROUND(SUM(planned_pab),0) AS planned_pab_total FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_planned_weekly GROUP BY organization_code, target_week_start, CAST(snapshot_week AS DATE) ORDER BY target_week_start, snapshot_week

datasets.name: ds_plan_change_items
queryLines: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT item_id, item_description, organization_code AS org, organization_code, target_week_start, planned_pab, FIRST_VALUE(planned_pab) OVER (PARTITION BY item_bigint_key, organization_code, target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week ASC) AS first_plan, FIRST_VALUE(planned_pab) OVER (PARTITION BY item_bigint_key, organization_code, target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week DESC) AS last_plan, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_bigint_key, organization_code, target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week DESC) AS rn FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_planned_weekly ) SELECT item_id, item_description, org, org AS organization_code, target_week_start, ROUND(first_plan,0) AS first_plan, ROUND(last_plan,0) AS last_plan, ROUND(last_plan-first_plan,0) AS plan_change FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND first_plan <> last_plan ORDER BY ABS(last_plan-first_plan) DESC LIMIT 100

datasets.name: ds_mom
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', week_start) AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(AVG(planned_pab),0) AS avg_planned_pab, ROUND(AVG(actual_end_on_hand),0) AS avg_actual_oh, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(onhand_variance_pct,0.5),1) AS median_var_pct FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE planned_pab IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', week_start) AS DATE) ORDER BY org, month

datasets.name: ds_po_timing
queryLines: SELECT lane, org, org AS organization_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(AVG(slip_days),1) AS avg_slip_days, ROUND(100.0*AVG(late_flag),1) AS pct_late FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.p1flow_order_stage_gold WHERE late_flag IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lane, org ORDER BY lane, org

datasets.name: ds_rootcause_dc
queryLines: WITH g AS ( SELECT organization_code, onhand_variance_dollar, planned_pab, actual_end_on_hand, planned_safety_stock, onhand_variance_abs, shipped_variance_abs, actual_po_received, onhand_variance_pct, CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NULL THEN 'Unplanned (no baseline)' WHEN planned_safety_stock>0 AND

actual_end_on_hand < planned_safety_stock THEN 'Stockout / below safety stock' WHEN ABS(COALESCE(shipped_variance_abs,0)) >= ABS(onhand_variance_abs)*0.5 THEN 'Demand change (ship vs plan)' WHEN COALESCE(actual_po_received,0) > 0 AND ABS(onhand_variance_abs) > 0 THEN 'Supply receipt timing/qty' WHEN

actual_end_on_hand > 3*planned_safety_stock AND planned_safety_stock>0 THEN 'Excess build-up' ELSE 'Plan drift (residual)' END AS root_cause FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE onhand_status IN ('red','yellow') AND week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max AND (size(:org_f)

= 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, root_cause, COUNT(*) AS item_weeks, ROUND(SUM(ABS(onhand_variance_dollar)),0) AS dollar_at_risk FROM g GROUP BY organization_code, root_cause ORDER BY dollar_at_risk DESC

datasets.name: ds_rootcause_plant
queryLines: SELECT org, organization_code, root_cause, txns, total_qty FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rootcause_plant ORDER BY total_qty DESC

datasets.name: ds_fva
queryLines: WITH s AS ( SELECT organization_code, planned_pab, actual_end_on_hand, LAG(actual_end_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY item_bigint_key, org_bigint_key ORDER BY week_start) AS naive_fcst FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE planned_pab IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_on_hand IS NOT

NULL AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, ROUND(AVG(ABS(actual_end_on_hand-planned_pab)),0) AS plan_abs_err, ROUND(AVG(ABS(actual_end_on_hand-naive_fcst)),0) AS naive_abs_err,

ROUND(100.0*(AVG(ABS(actual_end_on_hand-naive_fcst))-AVG(ABS(actual_end_on_hand-planned_pab)))/NULLIF(AVG(ABS(actual_end_on_hand-naive_fcst)),0),1) AS fva_pct FROM s WHERE naive_fcst IS NOT NULL GROUP BY organization_code ORDER BY org

datasets.name: ds_bias_persist
queryLines: WITH signed AS ( SELECT item_bigint_key, org_bigint_key, organization_code, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_variance_abs>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wks_over, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_variance_abs<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wks_under, COUNT(*) AS wks FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE

onhand_variance_abs IS NOT NULL AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) GROUP BY item_bigint_key, org_bigint_key, organization_code HAVING COUNT(*)>=4 ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, 'Persistently over-planned' AS bias_type, SUM(CASE WHEN

wks_over>=0.8*wks THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS items FROM signed GROUP BY organization_code UNION ALL SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, 'Persistently under-planned', SUM(CASE WHEN wks_under>=0.8*wks THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM signed GROUP BY organization_code ORDER BY org, bias_type

datasets.name: ds_acc_leadtime
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN requested_lead_time_days<=14 THEN '1 · Short (<=14d)' WHEN requested_lead_time_days<=45 THEN '2 · Medium (15-45d)' ELSE '3 · Long (>45d)' END AS lead_band, org, org AS organization_code, COUNT(*) AS po_lines, ROUND(AVG(slip_days),1) AS avg_slip_days, ROUND(100.0*AVG(late_flag),1) AS

pct_late FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.p1flow_po_stages WHERE requested_lead_time_days IS NOT NULL AND (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, org)) GROUP BY 1, org ORDER BY lead_band, org

datasets.name: ds_mape_trend
queryLines: SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, week_start, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN planned_pab IS NOT NULL AND planned_pab<>0 THEN ABS(onhand_variance_pct) END),1) AS mape, 15.0 AS target_mape FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE (size(:org_f) = 0 OR
array_contains(:org_f, organization_code)) GROUP BY organization_code, week_start ORDER BY week_start, org

datasets.name: ds_drill_sku
queryLines: SELECT week_start, organization_code AS org, organization_code, ROUND(SUM(planned_pab),0) AS planned_pab, ROUND(SUM(actual_end_on_hand),0) AS actual_oh, ROUND(SUM(planned_safety_stock),0) AS safety_stock, ROUND(SUM(actual_end_on_hand - planned_pab),0) AS gap_units, ROUND(SUM(onhand_variance_dollar),0) AS gap_dollar, ROUND(ABS(SUM(onhand_variance_dollar)),0) AS abs_gap_dollar, ROUND(SUM(actual_po_received),0) AS received, ROUND(SUM(actual_shipped),0) AS shipped, ROUND(SUM(planned_sales_orders),0) AS planned_so, ROUND(SUM(actual_end_on_hand)/NULLIF(SUM(actual_shipped),0),1) AS weeks_of_cover, ROUND(SUM(SUM(actual_end_on_hand - planned_pab)) OVER (ORDER BY week_start),0) AS cum_gap_units, MAX(onhand_status) AS status, CASE WHEN MAX(onhand_status)='red' THEN '3 · Off plan (>30%)' WHEN MAX(onhand_status)='yellow' THEN '2 · Drifting (15-30%)' WHEN MAX(onhand_status)='green' THEN '1 · On plan (<=15%)' ELSE '0 · No actual' END AS band, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE item_id = :sku AND week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max GROUP BY week_start, organization_code ORDER BY week_start

datasets.name: ds_plan_nervous
queryLines: WITH pw AS ( SELECT organization_code, target_week_start, snapshot_week, SUM(planned_pab) AS plan_total FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_planned_weekly GROUP BY organization_code, target_week_start, snapshot_week ), r AS ( SELECT organization_code, target_week_start, FIRST_VALUE(plan_total) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_code,target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week ASC) AS first_plan, FIRST_VALUE(plan_total) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_code,target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week DESC) AS last_plan, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY organization_code,target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week DESC) AS rn FROM pw ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, target_week_start, ROUND(100.0*(last_plan-first_plan)/NULLIF(ABS(first_plan),0),1) AS net_revision_pct, ROUND(last_plan-first_plan,0) AS net_revision_units FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY target_week_start

datasets.name: ds_plan_converge
queryLines: WITH pw AS ( SELECT organization_code, target_week_start, snapshot_week, SUM(planned_pab) AS plan_total FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_planned_weekly GROUP BY organization_code, target_week_start, snapshot_week ), d AS ( SELECT organization_code, plan_total - LAG(plan_total) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_code,target_week_start ORDER BY snapshot_week) AS wow_change, CAST(DATEDIFF(target_week_start, snapshot_week)/7 AS INT) AS weeks_to_target FROM pw ) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, weeks_to_target, ROUND(AVG(ABS(wow_change)),0) AS avg_abs_plan_change FROM d WHERE wow_change IS NOT NULL AND weeks_to_target>=0 AND weeks_to_target<=20 GROUP BY organization_code, weeks_to_target ORDER BY weeks_to_target

datasets.name: ds_drill_field
queryLines: SELECT item_id, item_description, organization_code, week_start, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) AS weeks_ago, planned_pab, actual_end_on_hand, planned_safety_stock, planned_sales_orders, actual_shipped, actual_po_received, onhand_variance_dollar AS gap_dollar, ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) AS abs_gap_dollar, (actual_end_on_hand - planned_pab) AS gap_units, SUM(actual_end_on_hand - planned_pab) OVER (PARTITION BY item_bigint_key, org_bigint_key ORDER BY week_start) AS cum_gap_units, ROUND(actual_end_on_hand/NULLIF(actual_shipped,0),1) AS weeks_of_cover, onhand_status, CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN '3 · Off plan (>30%)' WHEN onhand_status='yellow' THEN '2 · Drifting (15-30%)' WHEN onhand_status='green' THEN '1 · On plan (<=15%)' ELSE '0 · No actual' END AS band FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual

datasets.name: ds_cockpit_change
queryLines: WITH filt AS (SELECT * FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max), wks AS (SELECT DISTINCT week_start, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) r FROM filt), thisw AS (SELECT week_start w FROM wks WHERE r=1), priorw AS (SELECT week_start w FROM wks WHERE r=2), cur AS (SELECT * FROM filt WHERE week_start=(SELECT w FROM thisw)), prv AS (SELECT item_id, organization_code, onhand_status ps FROM filt WHERE week_start=(SELECT w FROM priorw)), j AS (SELECT cur.*, prv.ps FROM cur LEFT JOIN prv ON cur.item_id=prv.item_id AND cur.organization_code=prv.organization_code) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' AND COALESCE(ps,'')<>'red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newly_red, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' AND COALESCE(ps,'')<>'red' THEN ABS(onhand_variance_dollar) ELSE 0 END),0) AS newly_red_dollar, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status<>'red' AND ps='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_red, SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_red, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_tier LIKE '3%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS escalations FROM j GROUP BY organization_code

datasets.name: ds_cockpit_actions
queryLines: WITH filt AS (SELECT * FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE week_start BETWEEN :wk.min AND :wk.max), wks AS (SELECT DISTINCT week_start, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) r FROM filt), thisw AS (SELECT week_start w FROM wks WHERE r=1), priorw AS (SELECT week_start w FROM wks WHERE r=2), cur AS (SELECT * FROM filt WHERE week_start=(SELECT w FROM thisw)), prv AS (SELECT item_id, organization_code, onhand_status ps FROM filt WHERE week_start=(SELECT w FROM priorw)), ch AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_ref, org, chronic_pct_late FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.p1flow_order_stage_gold WHERE lane='purchase') SELECT cur.item_id, cur.item_description, cur.organization_code AS org, cur.organization_code, cur.abc, COALESCE(cur.planner_name,'Unassigned') AS planner_name, ROUND(ABS(cur.onhand_variance_dollar),0) AS dollar_at_risk, CASE WHEN cur.planned_safety_stock>0 AND cur.actual_end_on_hand<cur.planned_safety_stock THEN 'EXPEDITE (below safety stock)' WHEN cur.planned_safety_stock>0 AND cur.actual_end_on_hand>3*cur.planned_safety_stock THEN 'DEFER / CANCEL inbound (overstock)' WHEN ch.chronic_pct_late>=60 THEN 'FIX SUPPLIER (chronic late)' ELSE 'REVIEW' END AS action, CASE WHEN ch.chronic_pct_late>=60 THEN 'Systemic (chronic supplier)' ELSE 'One-off' END AS root_flag FROM cur JOIN prv ON cur.item_id=prv.item_id AND cur.organization_code=prv.organization_code LEFT JOIN ch ON cur.item_id=ch.item_ref AND cur.organization_code=ch.org WHERE cur.onhand_status='red' AND prv.ps<>'red' ORDER BY dollar_at_risk DESC LIMIT 200

END systemic FROM cur JOIN prv ON cur.item_id=prv.item_id AND cur.organization_code=prv.organization_code LEFT JOIN ch ON cur.item_id=ch.item_ref AND cur.organization_code=ch.org WHERE cur.onhand_status='red' AND prv.ps<>'red'), so AS (SELECT organization_code, SUM(CASE WHEN week_start=(SELECT w FROM thisw) AND planned_safety_stock>0 AND actual_end_on_hand<planned_safety_stock THEN SELECT so.organization_code AS org, so.organization_code, ROUND(so.so_cur-so.so_prev,0) AS net_swing_usd, ROUND(so.so_cur,0) AS stockout_cur_usd, ROUND(so.excess_cur,0) AS excess_usd, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN nr.systemic=1 THEN nr.d ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(nr.d),0),1) AS pct_dollar_systemic FROM so LEFT JOIN nr ON so.organization_code=nr.organization_code GROUP BY so.organization_code, so.so_cur, so.so_prev, so.excess_cur

ranked.actual_end_on_hand<ranked.planned_safety_stock THEN 'EXPEDITE' WHEN ranked.planned_safety_stock>0 AND ranked.actual_end_on_hand>3*ranked.planned_safety_stock THEN 'DEFER/CANCEL' WHEN ch.chronic_pct_late>=60 THEN 'FIX SUPPLIER' ELSE 'REVIEW' END AS action FROM ranked LEFT JOIN ch ON

ORDER BY week_start, action

datasets.name: ds_cp_aging
queryLines: WITH seq AS (SELECT item_id, organization_code, onhand_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY week_start DESC) wk_rank FROM sandbox_operations.po_management.rung2_plan_vs_actual WHERE (size(:org_f) = 0 OR array_contains(:org_f, organization_code))), streak AS (SELECT item_id, organization_code,

SUM(CASE WHEN onhand_status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rw FROM seq WHERE wk_rank<=8 GROUP BY item_id, organization_code) SELECT organization_code AS org, organization_code, CASE WHEN rw>=6 THEN '3 · 6+ wks (festering)' WHEN rw>=3 THEN '2 · 3-5 wks' WHEN rw>=1 THEN '1 · 1-2 wks (fresh)' END AS

age_band, COUNT(*) AS items FROM streak WHERE rw>0 GROUP BY organization_code, CASE WHEN rw>=6 THEN '3 · 6+ wks (festering)' WHEN rw>=3 THEN '2 · 3-5 wks' WHEN rw>=1 THEN '1 · 1-2 wks (fresh)' END ORDER BY age_band

# How to use this dashboard
**Filters (left):**
- **Org / DC** — pick a distribution center: **2012** (Olive Branch, US) or **2120** (Mexico). Affects every page *except* **5 · Cross-Org** (which compares both by design) and the **plant-movement** tile on page 7 (those are upstream plants 1006–1021, a different org set).
- **Week range** — the reporting window. On **0 · Monday Cockpit** it *replays* that week (recomputes 'this week vs last').
- **Weeks lookback** — a relative 'last N weeks' slider (1 = most recent week).
- **ABC class** — item value tier (Pareto): **A = high-value 'vital few', D = low-value 'long tail'.** Narrows item-level tiles.
- **Plan-fit band** — how far off plan: On-plan (≤15%) / Drifting (15–30%) / Off-plan (>30%).

**Pages:** 0 Cockpit = *what to do today* · 1 Overview = *state* · 2 Accuracy = *are our plans any good* · 3 Exceptions = *the cost-ranked queue* · 4 Drill = *one SKU's story* · 5 Cross-Org = *2012 vs 2120* · 6 Scenarios · 7 Plan Changes = *what changed & timing*.

Start here. **Reacts to the Org filter (see 2012 vs 2120's Monday) and ABC (focus the action list); the Week-range picker replays any past Monday** (it recomputes 'this vs last week' for the chosen window). KPIs = week-over-week swing; the action list is your ranked to-do (item · $ · verb · systemic/one-off); escalations = what's newly screaming. Drill pages 1–7 for the *why*. _(The weeks-ago slider doesn't apply here — use the date picker.)_

lines: # 2 · Plan Accuracy & Bias — how good are our plans, honestly

Bias is shown as **direction** (share of items over / under / on plan), not an outlier-inflated average. The scorecard grades each org against the agreed SLAs (O6). Watch the drift and whether A-items are planned tighter than C/D.

frame.title: Accuracy vs SLA (O6): MAPE target <15% — both orgs currently miss it

lines: ## Forecast Value Add — is planning better than doing nothing?

FVA compares the plan's on-hand projection against a naive 'next week = this week's actual' benchmark. **Positive = planning adds value; negative = the plan is WORSE than the naive guess.** Both orgs are currently negative — a hard signal the planning process is destroying, not adding, forecast value.

frame.title: Forecast Value Add % (negative = plan worse than naive) — both orgs NEGATIVE
Plan error vs naive benchmark — the FVA proof

lines: ## Correctable bias — the systematic (fixable) share of the problem

Items off-plan the SAME direction ≥80% of weeks = persistent bias a planner can correct (bias it down/up), vs random noise. ~26% of off-plan items are correctable this way — a concrete worklist, not a variance number.

frame.title: Persistently biased items (correctable) — over vs under, by org

lines: ## Accuracy trend vs the 15% SLA target — are we improving?
Weekly on-hand MAPE against the agreed <15% goal (O6). Volatile and far above target — accuracy is not stabilizing.

lines: _How to read: **negative = the plan is WORSE than a naive 'next week = this week' guess** — planning is destroying value, not adding it._
_How to read: items off-plan the SAME direction most weeks = a **correctable bias** (systematically bias them down/up), vs random noise._
_How to read: average receipt slip by supplier lead-time band. Counterintuitively, **short-lead items slip most** here — a broken fast-replenishment process._
# 3 · Monday Action List — worst plan misses, cost-ranked, with what to do

One row per item (its worst week), red/yellow only, ranked by **$ at risk**. **Root** flags whether it's a chronic-supplier problem (fix the source) or a one-off. Use the global filters to slice by band / ABC / org.

lines: ## Why did 2012 / 2120 miss plan? (root cause — DC signals)
Each off-plan item-week attributed to its dominant driver from the DC's own signals (2.3.7). 'Plan drift' = moved without one clear flow cause. $ at risk = |on-hand gap| × cost.

lines: # 4 · SKU Drill-down — one item (or All), plan vs actual, and the gap that matters

**Pick a SKU** (leave blank = All items = portfolio view). Reacts to the Org filter, weeks-ago slider and date range. **The gap** = actual on-hand − planned PAB: positive = piling up vs plan, negative = draining faster (stockout risk). If a SKU lives at both DCs you'll see a line per org.

lines: _How to read: the running total of the plan-vs-actual gap. A line that keeps climbing = the gap is **compounding**, not self-correcting._
# 5 · Cross-Org Contrast — one dashboard, every org

Every tile groups **by org** (never filters to one), so a new org appears automatically when it lands in the gold — no new dashboard. Contrast is shown in **relative** terms (%, ratios, per-item, percentiles) so a small org (2120, ~1/24th the $ base) is comparable to a large one (2012). Raw scale appears once, where the gap itself is the point.

lines: # 7 · Plan Changes & Timing — what changed, and did it land on time

The plan is re-forecast every week. **Nervousness** (left) = net revision per week (negative = walked down); **Convergence** (right) = do revisions shrink as the week nears (funnel to 0). **Reacts to the Org filter** (per-DC). _By design NOT filtered: the time controls (nervousness/convergence/MoM span all forecast horizons & months) and the plant-movements tile below (it's the upstream plant orgs 1006–1021, a different org universe from 2012/2120)._

lines: _How to read: each bar = how much that week's plan was revised from its first forecast to its latest. **Below zero = the plan was cut** (over-optimistic planning). Near zero = stable._
